name: craft-context
description: Standalone governed knowledge, scoped memory, and reproducible context for AI hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Give an Agent governed knowledge and memory.
interface.longDescription: Connect scoped knowledge sources, preserve evidence-linked memory, and resolve the smallest reproducible context pack. It never grants execution authority or silently imports private chat history.
defaultPrompt: Use Craft Context to resolve the smallest relevant knowledge and memory set for this request. Explain the selected source versions and do not write a durable memory unless I explicitly approve it.
